stories.title: Ewloe homes fight reaches planning inspector as councillor lodges 39-page objection
stories.summary: A Hawarden community councillor has urged a planning inspector to throw out a developer’s appeal over 315 homes on farmland in Ewloe. stories.title: Holywell care home rated excellent by Care Inspectorate Wales
stories.summary: A care home near Holywell for adults with learning disabilities and autism has been rated excellent in three of four areas by Care Inspectorate Wales. stories.title: 106 fewer GP practices in Wales since 2012 as average list tops 9,000 patients
stories.summary: Each full-time equivalent GP in Wales now has 30 per cent more patients than in 2012, according to the British Medical Association (BMA). Its latest Save Our Surgeries report says the number of GP practices fell from 474 to 368 over the same period, while the average practice list grew from 6,694 to 9,025 patients.

stories.summary: A woman from Flintshire has been jailed for eight years for perverting the course of justice and drug supply offences, following a child sexual exploitation investigation in Rhyl. stories.title: Commission proposes 3% rise in councillor pay across Wales
stories.summary: Councillors in Wales would get a 3 per cent pay rise in 2027-28, taking their basic salary to £21,676, under draft proposals published by the Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru.
